title: ^ETHICAL ISSUES OF ANIMALS IN SOCIETY
description: Provides an opportunity to discuss, debate and write extensively about current, relevant, and controversial social issues dealing with modern animal agriculture.
registration_restrictions:
Students with a term class standing of Freshman or Sophomore may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in Animal Sciences (125) or Rangeland Sciences (292).
